題目 1. 程序的執行由一個CPU執行和一個 io 等待的週期組成。(請用小寫英文回答)
Question 2. Which synchronization tool can be used to solve various synchronization problems, not just mutual exclusion?
A. Binary Semaphore
B. Spinlock
C. Mutex Lock
D. Counting Semaphore
題目 3. 關於無忙碌等待的信號量（Semaphore），以下哪些陳述是正確的？
A. wakeup() 操作會將程序從等待佇列移到就緒佇列
B. block() 操作會將程序放入等待佇列
C. 它有一個關聯的等待佇列
D. S->value 的值可以小於0
題目 4. 哪些是解決同步問題的替代方法？
A. OpenMP
B. 事務記憶體
C. 忙碌等待
D. 功能性程式設計語言
題目 5. 信號（Semaphore）的 wait() 和 signal() 操作必須是不可分割的（indivisible），這是為了什麼？
A. 確保公平性
B. 增加吞吐量
C. 提高效率
D. 防止競爭條件
題目 6. 哪種同步機制被稱為「自旋鎖」（spinlock）？
A. Monitor
B. Condition Variable
C. Mutex Lock
D. Semaphore with waiting queue
Question 7. openmp is a high-level parallel programming API that uses compiler directives to handle critical sections.(Please answer in lowercase English)
Question 8. The signal(full) operation is used in which process of the Bounded-Buffer Problem?
A. Neither uses it
B. Both use it
C. Producer
D. Consumer
題目 9. 哪種同步工具提供了 wait() 和 signal() 操作？
A. Condition variables
B. Mutex locks
C. Monitors
D. Semaphores
Question 10. The value of a binary semaphore can only range between "1" and "0".(Please enclose numbers in quotation marks, e.g., "9")
Question 11. In the bounded-buffer problem, wait(empty) and wait(mutex) are both used in the producer process.(Please answer in lowercase English)
題目 12. 在哲學家進餐問題中，共享的資料集是什麼？
A. 麵包
B. 米飯
C. 刀子
D. 叉子
題目 13. 關於監視器（Monitors），以下哪些陳述是正確的？
A. 它是高階的抽象概念
B. 內部變數只能被監視器內的程式碼存取
C. 一次只能有一個程序在監視器內活躍
D. 它可以解決所有同步問題
Question 14. When a process calls wait(mutex) and the lock is not available, it enters busy waiting.(Please answer in lowercase English)
Question 15. In the solution to the Dining Philosophers Problem, which methods can be adopted to prevent deadlock?
A. A philosopher always eats only after all their neighbors have finished eating
B. Allow at most four philosophers to try to eat at the same time
C. Odd-numbered philosophers pick up the left chopstick first, and even-numbered philosophers pick up the right chopstick first
D. A philosopher cannot pick up any chopstick unless they have both chopsticks
題目 16. 哪些是 Peterson's Solution 的優點？
A. 實作簡單
B. 滿足互斥、進度和有限等待要求
C. 適用於多於兩個程序
D. 不會導致忙碌等待
題目 17. 在Reader-Writer問題的解決方案中，哪些Semaphores被使用？
A. full
B. rw_mutex
C. mutex
D. read_count
題目 18. 在 Java 中，哪一個關鍵字可以用來確保方法或程式碼區塊的原子性？
A. synchronized
B. transient
C. atomic
D. volatile
題目 19. 在有界緩衝區問題中，消費者等待的信號量是哪一個？
A. mutex
B. empty
C. full
D. buffer
Question 20. Peterson's Solution 是一種針對兩個程序解決臨界區問題的 software 解決方案。(請用小寫英文回答)
題目 21. 哪種同步工具提供了 wait() 和 signal() 兩個原子操作？
A. Monitor
B. Mutex Lock
C. Semaphore
D. Spinlock
Question 22. Which synchronization tool is considered a high-level abstraction that provides a convenient and effective mechanism for process synchronization?
A. Mutex
B. Monitor
C. Semaphore
D. Spinlock
Question 23. The x.wait() operation in a monitor suspends a process until what happens?
A. Until another process calls x.signal()
B. Until a timer expires
C. Until all other processes enter the critical section
D. Until the process is woken up by the scheduler
Question 24. In the solution to the Readers-Writers Problem, the read_count variable is used to track how many readers are currently reading.(Please answer in lowercase English)
題目 25. 哪兩種同步工具通常會導致忙碌等待（busy waiting）？
A. Spinlock
B. Monitor
C. Mutex Lock
D. Semaphore with a waiting queue
題目 26. 監視器中條件變數的兩個主要操作是什麼？
A. wait()
B. signal()
C. release()
D. acquire()
Question 27. signal(full) is an operation executed after adding a new iten to notify the consumer that an item can be taken from the buffer.(Please answer in lowercase English, leaving a space between each word)
題目 28. 信號量是一種同步工具，它提供了比互斥鎖更 sophisticated 的方式來同步程序的活動。(請用小寫英文回答)
題目 29. signal(mutex) 和 signal(full) 都是在有界緩衝區問題的哪一個程序中使用的？
A. 消費者
B. 都不使用
C. 兩者都使用
D. 生產者
Question 30. One way to implement a semaphore is to use a waiting queue where each entry contains a value and a pointer to the next record in the list.(Please answer in lowercase English)
